drafts.text: Thank you for taking the time to write this. A dripping faucet sounds small, but I'm glad we got someone out the same week so it wasn't dripping into your weekend. And I appreciate you noticing the kitchen — we should leave every work site as clean as we found it, so hearing it actually happened means a lot. That friendliness from the first call comes from the whole crew, and I'll pass your kind words along. If anything else acts up, you know where to find us.

We are sorry the water heater swap needed a second visit. You are right to expect the job finished the first time. Your two-year workmanship warranty covers this repair, and we'll come back to check the fittings at no charge. Call us any morning and we'll make it right.

drafts.text: Thank you for this. The boot covers and the shutoff valve walkthrough are exactly the details I care about — you should finish a job knowing your own plumbing a little better than when we arrived. Hearing that the crew took pride in the work means a lot, because it tells me the standards I hold are the ones you actually felt on the ground. Thanks for trusting us with your home and for taking the time to say so.

That's not how a job should go, and I'm sorry. An hour late is on us, no way around it. And rushing an install worries me more than the lateness - it's the kind of shortcut that causes problems later. I'd like to hear it from you directly. Call us between seven and five, Monday through Saturday, and you'll reach a person, not a machine. Every repair we do carries a two-year workmanship warranty, so if the install isn't right or doesn't hold, we'll come back and make it right at no charge.

That's on us. A wrong part on the first visit, a valve that didn't hold overnight, water in your cabinet, and now a broken tap — none of that is the job you paid for, and I won't make excuses for it. Here's what happens next: call the shop between seven and five, Monday through Saturday, and you'll reach a person, not a machine. This repair is covered by our two-year workmanship warranty, so we come back and make it right at no charge to you. Ask for me when you call — if something about a job bothers you, I want to hear it myself.

Leaving your basement dusty after a big job is on us, and nobody coming back to sweep makes it worse. A tidy work site matters to me as much as the repair itself, and we fell short of that here. No excuses. Call the shop between seven and five, Monday through Saturday, and ask for me. You'll reach a person, not a machine. I want to hear this one from you directly so I can find out where our cleanup went wrong.
